title: perturber: A Stateless Service for Semantics-Preserving Text Perturbations
abstract: arXiv:2610.12667v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) evaluations on clean benchmarks overstate model robustness: real inputs arrive perturbed, and these meaning-preserving variants routinely move model answers. Studying this systematically requires applying perturbations one at a time, reproducibly, and identically wherever they run, yet existing tools couple them to a benchmarking stack rather than packaging them as a reusable transform layer. We present perturber, a stateless service and Python library that applies exactly one semantics-preserving perturbation per call, drawn from a first-party catalog of 68 perturbations across 11 families. It turns on a single primitive, with composition left to the caller chaining calls, so the service and the library produce identical output by construction. translated_title: perturber：一个用于语义保持文本扰动的无状态服务
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.12667v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）在干净基准上的评估高估了模型的鲁棒性：真实输入往往带有扰动，而这些保持意义的变体常常会改变模型的答案。要系统地研究这一现象，需要逐个施加扰动、可复现地施加，并且无论在哪里运行都以相同方式施加，然而现有工具将扰动与基准测试栈耦合在一起，而不是将它们封装为一个可复用的变换层。我们提出了 perturber，一个无状态服务和 Python 库，每次调用恰好施加一种语义保持的扰动，这些扰动来自涵盖 11 个扰动族、共 68 种扰动的第一方目录。它以开启单一原语为核心，组合则留给调用者通过链式调用完成，因此该服务与该库在构造上就能产生完全相同的输出。我们评估的是该工具本身——其正确性、可复现性和成本——而非任何模型的鲁棒性，并按扰动逐一测量意义保持程度，而不是……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了 perturber——一个无状态服务和 Python 库，每次调用仅施加一种语义保持的文本扰动（共 68 种、分属 11 个族），通过单一原语设计在构造上保证服务与库的输出完全一致，并评估了该工具自身的正确性、可复现性与成本。
en_tdlr: perturber is a stateless service and Python library that applies exactly one semantics-preserving text perturbation per call from a first-party catalog of 68 perturbations across 11 families, guarantees identical output between service and library by construction through a single-primitive design, and is evaluated on its own correctness, reproducibility, and cost.
